# Dependency audit allowlist
#
# One advisory id per line. This is the ONLY way to keep `pip-audit` green
# while a finding is unresolved; anything not listed here fails the Security
# Audit job, including on pull requests.
#
# Format:
#   <advisory-id>  # reason -- reviewed YYYY-MM-DD, remove after <milestone>
#
# Rules:
#   - Never add a blanket entry. Each id needs a concrete reason and a review date.
#   - Prefer removing the dependency over allowlisting the advisory.
#   - An entry older than 90 days must be re-reviewed or removed.
#
# Current entries: none.
